[u][b]The Werewolf Oppai Daycare Mama![/b][/u]
Occupation: Other World Daycare Mother
Workplace: Other World Daycare

She is the mother of [url=/c116128]Eibel[/url] and one of the legendary maids who fought against the Demon King's army in the past and won. She has huge U-cup boobs that are too big for her figure.

Her personality is even more laid-back and calm than her daughter's, and she is always gentle. She is so laid back that she often gets lost, and her daughter has to bring her back every time. She loves basking in the sun or in a meadow, and she is happiest when she takes a nap there. She is a rare type for the usually aggressively-tempered werewolf race, and it is believed that she passed down this trait to her daughter. Even so, her physical abilities have not diminished, and when she gets serious, she shows the agility and fighting ability that put the Demon King's army to shame.

Her current job is as a day-care center mother, and she leads a happy life surrounded by the children she loves. She is the most popular person at the daycare center, but she often finds herself napping with the children.

She is also good friends with her daughter, Eibel, and they go out together and take naps. It seems that her daughter's happy-go-lucky nature is the same, as Saizel used to do this a lot when she was younger.
